//: Import map for the wv-* edge functions.
The agent and the spatial engine are workspace TypeScript packages whose
sources import each other with '.js' specifiers -- correct for what
TypeScript emits, unresolvable against what it reads. So the functions
import the BUILT output, where those specifiers are real files, and this
map turns the three bare package names into paths.
Build before deploying:  cd spatial && npm run build
The alternative, vendoring a bundle into the function directory, was
rejected: it puts a second copy of the agent in the repository that can
silently drift from the one the tests run against.
